subject: general
question: Who is authorised to conduct road tests on workshop vehicles?
solution:
The correct answer is __Only trained and certified personnel.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Only trained and certified personnel__ are authorised to conduct road tests on workshop vehicles.
 
• This ensures that the individuals performing the tests have the necessary knowledge and skills.
 
• It helps in maintaining the safety of the vehicles and minimizing risks during testing.
 
• Untrained personnel, visitors, or unrelated employees are not allowed to perform such activities to avoid potential hazards.
 
• Certification ensures accountability and adherence to safety protocols.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Safety Measures:**

 
 
• Trained personnel are aware of the safety protocols required during road tests.
 
• They can identify and address potential technical issues during testing.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Certification:**
 
 
• Certification validates the expertise of the personnel.
 
• It ensures compliance with industry standards and regulations.
